description: Global Food Assessment data is published by USDA Economic Research Service. The assessment reports grain demand, production and implied additional supply requirements. Its stated coverage is Participating world regions and subregions; current-year and ten-year projections. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed CSV resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Projected supply gaps depend on the assessment assumptions and are not observed shortages. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
